# Ashmill Cycle Works - service FAQ

Q: What torque do the headset cap bolts need?
A: The headset cap bolts torque to 5 Nm on the F-2 and F-4 frames. Going past 6 Nm rounds the expander plug, so set the driver with the bolt seated first.

Q: And the stem faceplate bolts?
A: Stem faceplate bolts torque to 10 Nm in the same star pattern.

Q: How often should the headset be re-greased?
A: Every 12 months for year-round commuters; 18 months for fair-weather bikes.
